claim_text: Ecological information has regime-dependent value for sparse water-quality reconstruction
non_claim_note: descriptive predictive result; no causal interpretation

claim_text: Temporal extrapolation and spatial missingness do not have the same information ranking
fail_condition: ranking is unstable across analytes and basins

claim_text: A shared ecology-time representation transfers across at least two target analytes under the preregistered K=5 gate
Transfer gains are present in at least three of five internal HUC6 targets
K=5 is no worse than K=0 and K=1 for the primary aggregate
True target support is used beyond support-site or support-value shuffles
fail_condition: true support does not beat both shuffles

claim_text: The transfer result reproduces in an independently selected external basin
fail_condition: external direction fails or requires retuning
non_claim_note: external failure narrows scope to ST357

claim_text: Empirical uncertainty calibration changes coverage and interval width in analyte- and basin-dependent ways
fail_condition: calibration or width cannot be recomputed

claim_text: Uncertainty ranking supports stable monitoring blind spots across tools or analytes
fail_condition: fewer than two independent tools or indicators pass
non_claim_note: closed by default unless a new gate passes

claim_text: The additional value of topology is conditional and must be demonstrated by matched controls
non_claim_note: topology is not a core claim by model name

claim_text: The transfer model does not harm a primary analyte/basin cell by more than 5% while pooled success is claimed
non_claim_note: pooled averages do not erase local failures

claim_text: All target labels outside support cells remain hidden during adaptation
non_claim_note: identity and visibility are part of the claim
